negative_findings.description: No public, itemised tender or award-notice feed was found for any of the four EU/Austrian/Slovenian/Hungarian parent groups (Erste, NLB, Addiko, OTP) covering supplier competitions for their Montenegrin subsidiaries. Erste and OTP expose supplier onboarding and policy documents only; Addiko exposes nothing supplier-facing at all; NLB's sole 'javni razpisi' channel publishes receivables/claims sales, not goods or services procurement.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero parent-level public tender feeds located across Erste, NLB and Addiko; OTP exposes onboarding only. Verified by fetching the OTP supplier page, the Erste Group Procurement page and the NLB javni razpisi page directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: for group-decided Montenegrin IT and payments spend there is no notice-style artefact to harvest. Collection must pivot from tender-notice scraping to onboarding-gate monitoring, press-release signal detection and disclosure-document mining.

negative_findings.description: Two of the cell's core actor acronyms are heavily polluted in English search. 'OTP ... tenders portal' returns the Ontario Tenders Portal (ontariotenders.app.jaggaer.com / ontariotenders.bravosolution.com) almost exclusively; 'NLB procurement portal' returns the Northern Lighthouse Board (nlb.delta-esourcing.com, nlb.g2b.info) and the unrelated IT firm NLB Services. English-only querying on these acronyms returns essentially zero true positives.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two English seed queries returned 100% false-positive top results; usable results only appeared after switching to hu ('beszállítói portál', 'beszerzés') and sl ('javni razpisi', 'nabava', 'dobavitelji').
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated crawler or alerting rule built on the bare acronyms will be swamped by Canadian and Scottish public-sector procurement noise. Queries must be entity-qualified ('OTP Bank Nyrt.', 'Nova Ljubljanska banka') or run in the parent's own language.

negative_findings.description: Targeted Montenegrin-language searches ('nabavka', 'javni poziv', 'tender', 'dobavljači') against Erste Bank AD Podgorica, NLB Banka AD Podgorica and CKB Banka surfaced no procurement, tender or supplier section on any of the three subsidiary websites.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three subsidiary sites checked via local-language search; no procurement/supplier page found on any.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Positive confirmation of the cell hypothesis — the buying signal genuinely does not appear locally — and a warning that cell 7 (local sources) will not pick these banks up either. The gap is structural, not a search failure.

negative_findings.description: No press release, award notice or vendor announcement was located tying a specific group-level card-processing, core-banking or payments framework agreement to the Montenegrin subsidiary of any of the five parents, in either English or Serbian/Montenegrin.

brief: For the foreign parents of Montenegro's banks there is no tender-notice layer to harvest: Erste, NLB, Addiko and OTP all buy centrally and none publishes an itemised competition feed covering the Montenegrin subsidiary. What exists instead is a three-tier landscape — onboarding gates (OTP's szállítóknak page routing into SAP Ariba; Erste Group Procurement in Vienna, which explicitly manages the entire external spend of all majority-owned group entities and publishes supplier terms, NDAs, audit questionnaires and scorecards), signal channels (group newsrooms at erstegroup.com, otpgroup.info and nlbgroup.com, plus sister-bank newsrooms such as otpbanka.hr that announce Montenegro-affecting decisions in Croatian), and disclosure mining (Addiko's Corporate Governance and Group Annual Reports, which confirm a Group procurement policy binding all entities above a threshold, and the EBA's DORA Register-of-Information regime, which inventories exactly these vendor relationships for the EU-supervised parents). The one genuine parent-level tender portal found is Turkish — Ziraat's ihale.ziraatbank.com.tr — and it needs a headless-browser retry before its category coverage can be judged. Local-language search was decisive but in an unexpected direction: Serbian queries produced only the actor map and the CBCG bank register, while every direct procurement source in this slice was reachable only in Hungarian, German, Slovenian or Turkish, and the bare English acronyms OTP and NLB are unusable, returning the Ontario Tenders Portal and the Northern Lighthouse Board respectively.
